title: Design focused functions
description: Keep functions short, with few parameters and shallow nesting, so that each one does one thing. CodeDNA measures the share of functions longer than 100 lines, with more than 5 parameters, or nested more than 4 levels deep.
objective: Fewer long functions, wide parameter lists and deeply nested functions.

steps.title: Understand single responsibility for functions
steps.description: A function should do one thing at one level of abstraction, and its name should say what that thing is. Length, many parameters and deep nesting are usually symptoms of a function doing several things.
steps.objective: Recognise when a function has more than one responsibility.

steps.title: Identify oversized functions
steps.description: Use the structural findings of your latest analysis (function length, parameter count and nesting depth) to list the functions that exceed the thresholds. Note which symptom each one shows.
steps.objective: A short list of functions to split, with the symptom of each.

steps.title: Reduce function length
steps.description: Extract cohesive blocks (a loop body, a validation, a calculation) into well-named functions. Keep the extracted pieces free of hidden shared state, so that each can be read on its own.
steps.objective: Functions short enough to read without scrolling.

steps.title: Reduce long parameter lists
steps.description: Group parameters that always travel together into one value object, replace boolean flags with separate functions, and pass only what the function uses.
steps.objective: Functions with at most five parameters.

steps.title: Reduce deep nesting
steps.description: Return early for edge cases, invert conditions, and move the body of a nested loop into its own function. Deep nesting hides which condition a line depends on.
steps.objective: Functions nested at most four levels deep.

steps.title: Review function boundaries
steps.description: Check that each function's name describes everything it does, and separate computation from side effects such as I/O, so that the computation can be tested on its own.
steps.objective: Function names that match what the functions do.

steps.title: Complete a function design challenge
steps.description: Practise on a short coding challenge for this competency. It is checked by deterministic tests and structural rules in an isolated sandbox.
steps.objective: Apply the techniques of this track to a small, self-contained exercise.

steps.title: Re-assess with a new analysis
steps.description: Apply these techniques to your own code, upload the changed source and run a new CodeDNA analysis. Only a new analysis can show whether the measured function design changed.
steps.objective: A new analysis of the improved code.
